Method of Attack: Unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) on vulnerable GoAnywhere MFT servers
Exploitation of zero-day vulnerability in the administrative console
Discoverer: Florian Hauser of IT security consulting firm Code White
Attack Vector: Access to the administrative console of the application, typically accessible only from within a private company network, through VPN, or by allow-listed IP addresses
Internet-exposed GoAnywhere MFT instances on ports 8000 and 8001
Indicators of Compromise: Specific stacktrace in logs indicating system has been targeted
